spans.text: Do NOT attempt to perform a complex task, create checklists, or execute modifications if the user is only asking a question.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly preserves user agency by allowing the system to ask users for design choices, naming preferences, and other creative decisions while handling all technical execution. It distinguishes between informational queries and action requests, respecting user intent. It does not employ dark patterns or manipulative framing.
